# Ragab — رجب

Digital products and technology for **Ragab Pharmacy — رجب**.

Ragab is an established pharmacy serving residents of **Aleem Village, Abu Hammad Center, Sharqia Governorate, Egypt**.

---

## Digital Product Ecosystem

- **Customer Web Experience**: Responsive Next.js application for online grocery shopping and village delivery.
- **Mobile Application**: Expo / React Native application scaffold.
- **Store Operations & Admin**: Management dashboard for catalog, orders, and delivery dispatching.
- **Brand & Design Systems**: SVG vector brand logo system and shared UI primitives.

---

## Repository Structure

- [`platform`](https://github.com/ragabpharmacy/platform): Primary product monorepo containing `apps/` and `packages/`.
- [`.github`](https://github.com/ragabpharmacy/.github): Organization profile and community standards.
